info.name: Eva
info.summary: Private AI assistant — RAG chat over your Nextcloud files with Ollama or Groq
info.description:
Eva AI turns your Nextcloud into a private, searchable knowledge base powered by Large Language Models. Ask questions in natural language and get instant, cited answers drawn from your own files — fully local with Ollama, or optionally via Groq for cloud-hosted inference.
## Why Eva AI?
Your data stays yours. No third-party indexing, no external databases, no cloud required. Eva runs entirely within your Nextcloud instance, giving you full control over your files and conversations.
## Key Features
**Intelligent File Indexing** Eva automatically reads, chunks, and embeds your files for semantic search. Supports a wide range of formats: plain text (txt, md, csv, json, xml, yaml, sql, ...), PDF, Microsoft Office (docx/xlsx/pptx with macros and templates), OpenDocument (odt/ods/odp), EPUB, saved mail (eml, mbox), web archives (mht/mhtml), Jupyter notebooks (ipynb), and many more. A file that cannot be read is skipped instead of stopping the run.
**Hybrid Retrieval Engine** Combines vector-based semantic search with lexical search (BM25) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to deliver the most relevant results — even for exact-match queries.
**Cited Sources** Every answer includes the exact file path where the information was found, so you can always verify the source. Answers that used the web list the pages they actually retrieved, with their site and an excerpt, marked as web sources.
**Nextcloud Integration** Eva can perform actions directly within Nextcloud: search for files, create documents, rename items, and work with templates across your entire home space — including Notes and Contacts.
**Ollama and Groq Support** Start fully local with Ollama (no configuration required) or optionally connect to Groq for cloud-hosted inference. Embeddings always run locally via Ollama.
**Zero Configuration** Just install and go. Eva automatically detects your local Ollama instance and selects appropriate models.
**Talk Integration** Optionally integrate with Nextcloud Talk for conversational AI within your chat rooms.
## Requirements
- Nextcloud 30–35 - PHP 8.2+ - [Ollama](https://ollama.com) running locally (default: http://localhost:11434) - Optional: Groq API key for cloud-hosted inference
## Get Started
1. Install the app 2. Ensure Ollama is running on your server 3. Open Eva from the left sidebar 4. Start chatting with your files
## Privacy
With Ollama, all processing happens on your server. Your files never leave your infrastructure. No analytics, no telemetry, no external calls.
